server.global.scrape_interval: How often Prometheus collects metrics from targets that use the default interval.
server.retention: How long Prometheus keeps stored samples.
server.persistentVolume.enabled: Store samples on a persistent volume so they survive replacement of the server Pod.
server.persistentVolume.size: Storage capacity requested for the Prometheus data volume.
server.resources: CPU and memory the Prometheus server requests and the limits Kubernetes enforces.
alertmanager.enabled: Include Alertmanager to receive and route alerts from Prometheus.
kube-state-metrics.enabled: Include an exporter that reports the state of Kubernetes objects as metrics.
